title: Make top-level TermAl CLI help discoverable without starting a server or session
outcome: A caller can discover supported TermAl commands with top-level --help/-h/help instead of receiving a fatal unknown-argument error. Help honestly distinguishes coordination CLI session listing from root-session creation through the existing supported UI/API; it must not imply termal_spawn_session creates roots or introduce a new creation/authority surface. Keep this a small help/dispatch fix, separate from adding a root creation CLI.
acceptance: Top-level --help, -h and help print useful command usage and exit successfully without starting the host, a runtime, a session or making a backend request.

Usage describes current supported modes and coordination commands, and clearly states that sessions list lists roots while delegation spawn creates children; root creation is directed to the existing UI/API documentation rather than a nonexistent CLI command.
Existing sessions/mailbox help and commands retain their behavior; focused tests cover top-level help dispatch and no-side-effect behavior.
disposal_reason: Duplicate: both items cover the same defect, top-level TermAl CLI --help/-h/help failing with "unknown argument" in main.rs Mode::parse. w-02f3bce82afe is claimed and in progress (Termal::Sol-c593, session-13170), so it carries the fix. Its holder adopts this item's three acceptance criteria verbatim, with Termal::Fable2's concurrence recorded on w-02f3bce82afe. Superseded by the TermAl coordinator, 2026-10-31 ~23:42Z.
